name: JUDAO sell-hook pair-reserve desynchronization
summary: JUDAO's sell hook moved JUDAO out of its own PancakeSwap pair (daily mining and burn), synced the lowered balance as the reserve, and only then completed the seller-to-pair transfer. With a flash loan the attacker bought JUDAO, sold it into the pair to trigger the hook, and used the balance-over-reserve gap as swap input to withdraw excess USDT.
notes: Reset: the buy 0x8149e077 (block 94912245, 20 hours before the anchor) set launched (slot 0xb), false from deployment. Until the pair's USDT reserve first reached 10M, every buy from the pair without a whitelisted party reverted "un launched", and the first buy after that latched the flag; the anchor's flash-loan buy of 5.47M JUDAO took that path, so this first opening of buys resets the age (rule 8). Sells had opened earlier: the owner's startup (0xb8da4ff5, block 75703853) set startTime (slot 0x9) to 2026-01-17 00:00 UTC, and every sale calls IDOFundPool.fundUSDT through the fund-pool pointer the owner set minutes after deployment (0x15213162, slot 0x14).

Loss is the pair's net USDT depletion, including fee-processing outflows to protocol recipients; JUDAO moved out of the pair is not valued separately. A scan of all pair USDT flows for same-tx buy-and-drain found no other exploit.
